title: Gold Saver Account: Transferring funds to external banks
summary: This document explains how to transfer funds from a Gold Saver Account to external banks: standard external transfers typically complete in 1 business day. It also states the daily transfer maximum is $25,000 per day and provides steps to add/verify the external account, confirm transfer details, and troubleshoot non-arrival or daily-limit issues.
